# Risk signals

Every `security.risks[].kind` whiff reports, with the `category` and `severity` the engine
attaches to it. `security.risk_level` is the highest severity among a file's own risks and
those of its embedded files; `security.embedded_risks` counts the embedded files' risks by
kind. A risk is a signal worth a look, not a verdict: most kinds also occur in benign files.

Severities: **high**, rarely legitimate or a known exploitation or deception technique;
**medium**, can act for the reader or reach out but has legitimate uses; **low**, common in
benign files; **info**, worth knowing only.

## Active content (`active_content`)

Code that can run: macros, scripts, actions, DDE.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_exec_macro` | high | Macro that runs automatically (`AutoOpen`, `Document_Open`, `Auto_Open` …) |
| `dde` | high | DDE field or formula that can launch a program |
| `executable_attachment` | high | Attached or embedded file is a program or script |
| `launch_action` | high | PDF action that launches a program or opens a file |
| `script_shortcut` | high | Shortcut starts a command interpreter (cmd, PowerShell, mshta, wscript …) with arguments |
| `suspicious_macro` | high | Macro uses shell, download, process or obfuscation calls |
| `xlm_macros` | high | Excel 4.0 (XLM) macro sheet |
| `active_content` | medium | SVG `<foreignObject>`: embedded HTML that a browser renders and may script |
| `alarm_procedure` | medium | Calendar alarm whose action runs a program (`ACTION:PROCEDURE`) |
| `auto_action` | medium | PDF action that runs on open, page view or similar without a click |
| `inline_event_handlers` | medium | HTML event-handler attributes (`onload=` …) |
| `inline_script` | medium | Raw `<script>` in Markdown |
| `javascript` | medium | PDF JavaScript |
| `javascript_urls` | medium | `javascript:` links |
| `macro_attachment` | medium | Attachment is a macro-enabled Office document |
| `macros` | medium | VBA or StarBasic macro project |
| `script` | medium | SVG `<script>` or event handlers |
| `shell_action` | medium | Workflow or shortcut has an action that runs a shell script or other code |

## Phishing (`phishing`)

Deceiving the reader: spoofed senders, misleading links, credential forms.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `display_name_spoof` | high | Sender display name shows an address other than the real sender |
| `double_extension` | high | Attachment name hides an executable behind a document extension |
| `link_text_mismatch` | high | Link text names one site while the link goes to another |
| `password_form` | high | Message or page asks for a password |
| `authentication_failure` | medium | SPF, DKIM or DMARC failed for the message |
| `external_form_action` | medium | HTML form submits to another site |
| `reply_to_mismatch` | medium | Replies go to a different domain from the sender's |
| `meta_refresh_redirect` | low | HTML redirects itself to another page |

## External references (`external_reference`)

Content fetched from elsewhere when the file is opened.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `external_template` | high | Document attaches a remote template (template injection) |
| `external_content` | medium | Field or frame that includes content from a URL or network path |
| `external_ole_link` | medium | OLE object linked to an external file or URL |
| `xinclude` | medium | XML includes another document (XInclude) |
| `external_reference` | low | SVG loads a resource from another site |
| `external_workbook_link` | low | Workbook formulas refer to another workbook |
| `form_submission` | low | PDF form submits its fields to a URL |
| `remote_goto` | low | PDF link that opens another document |
| `remote_image` | low | Image loaded from a URL when the document opens (can track the reader) |

## Exploit techniques (`exploit`)

Constructs tied to known exploitation techniques.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_update_object` | high | Embedded object refreshed automatically on open, a common exploit trigger |
| `decompression_bomb` | high | Expands to 1 GiB or more at over 100:1, or beyond the budget |
| `equation_editor_object` | high | Equation Editor 3.0 object, a classic Office exploit vector |
| `external_entity` | high | XML external entity (`SYSTEM` / `PUBLIC`), a vector for XXE |
| `overlapping_entries` | high | ZIP entries share their compressed data (an overlapping-entry zip bomb) |
| `path_traversal` | high | Archive entry whose path climbs out of the folder it is unpacked into (`../`) |
| `symlink_escape` | high | Archive symbolic link that points outside the archive (absolute or `../`) |
| `unsafe_deserialization` | high | Serialized data names code to run when it is loaded (pickle globals such as `os.system`, Java or PHP gadget classes) |
| `absolute_path` | medium | Archive entry with an absolute path, which an unpacker may write anywhere |
| `xml_entities` | low | DOCTYPE declares internal entities (entity expansion) |

## Obfuscation (`obfuscation`)

Content hidden from a casual look.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hidden_iframe` | high | Invisible `<iframe>` |
| `hidden_macro_sheet` | high | Excel 4.0 macro sheet hidden from the sheet tabs |
| `packed_executable` | medium | Executable is packed (UPX, or code with the entropy of compressed data): its code cannot be read statically |
| `obfuscated_code` | low | Compiled code processed by an obfuscator (named in the format section) |
| `tls_callbacks` | low | PE image runs TLS callbacks, code that starts before the entry point |
| `trailing_data` | low | Bytes after the end of the image, archive or compressed stream |

## Data exposure (`data_exposure`)

Secrets or credentials in the content.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `embedded_secret` | high | Credentials or keys found in the content |
| `secret_in_env` | high | Secret value set in an environment variable of a build file |
| `unprotected_key` | medium | Private or secret key stored without a passphrase (PEM, OpenSSH, PuTTY, OpenPGP, JWK, keytab, minisign) |

## Supply chain (`supply_chain`)

Installs, fetches or trusts code from elsewhere.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `broad_extension_permissions` | medium | Browser extension asks for all sites, native messaging or similar |
| `custom_package_index` | medium | Packages are installed from a non-default index |
| `install_script` | medium | Package runs scripts when it is installed |
| `installs_root_certificate` | medium | Configuration profile installs a root certificate the device will trust |
| `remote_add` | low | Dockerfile `ADD` fetches a URL |

## Unsafe operations (`unsafe_operation`)

Operations that change or destroy state with broad privileges.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `debuggable` | medium | App built debuggable (Android `debuggable`, iOS `get-task-allow`): a debugger can attach |
| `destructive_statements` | medium | SQL that drops or truncates tables or deletes without a condition |
| `privilege_changes` | medium | SQL that grants or revokes privileges or creates users |
| `weakened_runtime` | medium | Hardened-runtime exception: unsigned executable memory, library injection or `DYLD_` variables allowed |
| `writable_executable_memory` | medium | Executable maps memory that is writable and executable (W+X section or segment, executable stack) |
| `requests_elevation` | low | Program manifest asks to run as administrator (`requireAdministrator`) |
| `runs_as_root` | low | Container image runs as root |
| `weak_cryptography` | low | Weak key or algorithm: RSA / DSA under 2048 bits, MD5 or SHA-1 signatures, DES or RC4 keys, unsigned tokens |

## Provenance (`provenance`)

Where the content came from.

| Kind | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ai_generated` | info | Metadata says the image was generated or composited by an AI model |
